card.text: A-type star 7.70 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Fomalhaut is an A-type star 7.70 parsecs away and 1.84 times the Sun’s radius, known for its debris ring. Here its surface is a plain sphere.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of a measured spectrum of the star, from the ground. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.

dust-ring.title: Dust ring, 1.3 mm
dust-ring.summary: The narrow dust belt in its own glow at 1.3 mm, its centre 14 au off the star. Its depth is the tilted ring that fits.
